story.title: From Vietnamese Farms to Your Glowing Lips
story.p1: Gaco was born from a simple belief: Vietnam possesses incredible agricultural treasures like vibrant gac fruit and Ben Tre coconuts, yet consumers often resort to expensive chemical-laden cosmetics.
story.p2: We partner directly with local farming cooperatives to harvest the richest ripe gac fruit. Using gentle cold-press extraction without heat, our ruby gac oil blends seamlessly with pure coconut oil to deliver nature's purest restorative lip care.

ingredients.title: 100% Transparent Formula
ingredients.subtitle: No hidden additives, no chemical fillers – every pure drop serves a clear purpose in nourishing your lips.
ingredients.betaDesc: Vitamin A precursor from gac aril, accelerates epidermal renewal and smooths deep lip creases.
ingredients.lycopeneDesc: Antioxidant 10x stronger than Vitamin E, neutralizes free radicals, noticeably diminishes lip discoloration.
ingredients.vitEDesc: Locks in hydration for up to 8 hours, preventing dryness and cracking even in air-conditioned environments.
ingredients.lauricDesc: Natural antimicrobial fatty acid that creates a breathable shield against airborne impurities and mild UV.

timeline.title: 4 Cold-Press Steps Preserving Full Potency
timeline.step1Desc: Hand-harvested at peak maturity from verified farms, selecting vibrant red spiny fruits.
timeline.step2Desc: Delicately separating the red aril and convection drying at low temperature to preserve carotenoids.
timeline.step3Title: 3. Slow Cold Extraction with Coconut Oil
timeline.step3Desc: Mechanical pressing with zero artificial heat blended with 100% pure Ben Tre coconut oil.
timeline.step4Desc: Blended with vegan candelilla wax and poured into eco-friendly tubes in a GMP-certified cleanroom.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Does the balm contain lead or artificial colorants?
faq.a1: Absolutely not! The subtle natural blush comes directly from beta-carotene in organic gac fruit. Rigorously tested 0% lead and paraben-free.
faq.q2: Is it safe for pregnant women and small children?
faq.a2: Yes! Made entirely of food-grade vegan botanical oils, incidental ingestion is completely harmless, making it ideal for mothers and sensitive skin.
faq.q3: Does it genuinely fade lip discoloration?
faq.a3: Yes! High concentrations of lycopene and vitamin A/E suppress melanin production. Daily use for 2-4 weeks reveals visibly brighter, even-toned lips.
faq.a4: Inner Hanoi & HCMC takes 1-2 business days. Other provinces take 2-3 days. You can inspect upon delivery before payment.
